question: 24 unread marks that stand where a note's dot would be. For each number: is it a dot that lengthens the note to its left? Yes or no.
verbatim: One, no. Two, no. Three, no. Four, yes. Five, no. Six, yes. Seven, no. Eight, no. 9 yes, 10 yes, 11 yes, 12 yes, 13 yes, 14 yes, 15 yes, 16 no, 17 yes, 18 yes, 19 yes, 20 no, 21 no, 22 no, 23 no, 24 no. 24 is part of a bass clef. The others that are all no's are parts of a ledger line.
ours: 12 real dots, 12 not: 11 ledger-line pieces and 1 bass-clef piece.
